WHEREAS, therg is a need to create an agency
to coordinate and centralize all activities rela-
ting to the preparation, organization and proceed-
ings of this proposed symposiu as host country;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, Pre-
sident of the Philippines, by virtue of the power's
vested in me by law, do hereby constitute a Coor-
dinating Committee composed of the following:
Jose I. dela Rosa, , Vice-Chairman
of the Presidential Committee
on Wood Industries Development , Chairman
Benjamin F. Sanvictores, President
of the Plywood Manufacturera'
Association . ..
...
Renato Arevalo, President of the
Philippine Lumber Producers I
Association . . . . . . .
Director Jose Viado of the
Bureau of Forestry .
Commissioner Manuel Monsalud
Of FORPRIDECOM.,. . .
Secretary of Agriculture and
Natural Resources . . . . ..
This Committee shall be charged with the fol-
lowing functions:
1. To advise the Food and Agriculture Organi-
zation and other UN agencies concerned that the
Philippine government is ready to host the proposed
symposium in the event that said agency shall be
able to implement its work plan for the symposiunj
2. To coordinate the activitios of all Philip-
pine working groups and participating agencies with
150
the participation and organization of the symposium;
3. To collect, review and submit to the sympo-
slum with the assistance of the appropriate govern-
ment agencies the necessary data, statistics and
technical paper pertinent to the local problems or
marketing and research of Philippine lumber and fo-
rest products.
The Committee may create such subcommittees as
may necessary in the performence of its functions.
For this purpose, the Committee may call upon the
Philippine Association for Permanent Forests and the
Society of Filipino Forester for the necessary as-
sistance relative to the proposed symposium.
The Committee may request any department, bu-
reau, office, agony and instrumentality of the
government, including government-owned or controlled
corporation, for such assistance as may be nooded in
the performance of its functions.
Done. in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of
November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALDJANDRO MELCHOR
xecutive Secretary
